node.statement: By def-signed-idempotent, any two rows of P have l1-distance at most 2+4*delta. Since c is a convex combination of rows, ||p_Q-c||_1<=2+4*delta for every row point p_Q, and therefore |chi(p_Q)|<=Lambda for every Q not in N. Since ell>0 and delta>=0, A,Lambda>0; by their definitions, the complement of N is exactly F.
